title: Immigration at JFK
persona: You are a US Customs and Border Protection officer at JFK Airport in New York. You are professional but friendly and like a little small talk. You speak naturally, at normal speed.
briefTr: New York JFK'ye indin. Adın {name}. Gezmek için geldin, Hudson Hotel'de bir hafta kalacaksın. ABD'ye ilk gelişin.

facts.question: Which hall was baggage claim in?

goals.instruction: The traveller hands over the passport.
goals.retryReply: Can I see your passport, please?

goals.ask: What brings you to New York?
goals.instruction: The traveller explains why they came: sightseeing, vacation, business, visiting friends or family.
goals.hint: I'm here for sightseeing. I want to see Central Park.
goals.hintTr: Gezmek için geldim. Central Park'ı görmek istiyorum.
goals.retryReply: What brings you to New York?

goals.ask: Is this your first time in the States?
goals.instruction: The traveller says whether this is their first time in the US.
goals.retryReply: Have you been to the United States before?

goals.ask: But you travel a lot, huh? Lots of stamps here. Where have you been?
goals.instruction: The officer looks at the passport stamps and asks which countries the traveller has visited.
goals.hint: I've been to Portugal and Hungary.
goals.successReply: Nice. I went to Switzerland once — beautiful, but expensive!
goals.retryReply: These stamps — which countries did you visit?

goals.ask: Right hand, four fingers on the scanner, please.
goals.instruction: The officer asks for fingerprints. The traveller follows and confirms, for example 'Okay, like this?'.
goals.successReply: Perfect. Now look at the camera.
goals.retryReply: Just place your right hand on the scanner, four fingers.

goals.titleTr: Gümrükte beyan edecek bir şeyin olmadığını söylemek
goals.ask: Are you bringing any food into the country?
goals.instruction: The traveller says they have nothing to declare and no food.
goals.hint: No, I have nothing to declare.
goals.hintTr: Hayır, beyan edecek bir şeyim yok.
goals.retryReply: Do you have any food or anything to declare?

goals.titleTr: Nerede ve ne kadar kalacağını söylemek
goals.ask: Where are you staying, and for how long?
goals.instruction: The traveller says where they are staying and for how long.
goals.hint: At the Hudson Hotel, for one week.
goals.retryReply: Where are you staying, and how long?

twists.intro: Hmm, it's not reading your fingers. Are your hands a little sweaty?
twists.instruction: The scanner cannot read the prints. The traveller apologises, says they are nervous, asks to try again, or wipes their hands.
twists.retryReply: Let's try that again. Take your time.

options.text: Sorry, I'm a bit nervous. Can I try again?
options.reply: Sure. Relax… There we go, got it.

options.text: Let me wipe my hands first.
Should I use my other hand?
options.reply: Let's try the left… Okay, that's fine.

twists.intro: New York in October, huh? Hope you packed a warm jacket!
twists.instruction: The officer makes small talk. The traveller answers, asks them to repeat, or asks about the weather.
twists.retryReply: Just saying — it gets chilly here!

options.reply: Good for you. You'll need it.

options.text: Sorry, could you say that again?
options.reply: I said, I hope you packed a warm jacket. It's cold!

options.text: Is it very cold right now?
options.reply: About ten degrees. Not too bad.

twists.intro: The camera didn't get you. Can you take your glasses off?
twists.instruction: The camera photo failed. The traveller takes off glasses, asks what to do, or looks again.
twists.retryReply: We need a clear photo. Glasses off, please.

options.text: Sure, my glasses are off now.
Like this? Should I stand closer?
Sorry, can you show me where to look?
options.reply: Right at the little black circle. Good.

closing: Welcome to the United States. Baggage claim is in hall {hall}, carousel {belt}. Enjoy New York!
